pk.context: 105 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: white to off-white, opaque suspension in an amber glass bottle

tell: An oral suspension giving AUC equivalent to the IV infusion, for an ALS drug whose mechanism is still unknown.

clues.text: Oral bioavailability is about 57% because of first-pass effect; a high-fat meal cuts Cmax by 82% and AUC by 61%. It is 92% bound to serum protein and leaves mainly in urine as a glucuronide conjugate.
A white crystalline powder with a molecular weight of 174.20.
Under an NDA, an oral suspension of 105 mg per 5 mL in a multi-dose amber glass bottle. It does not accumulate with once-daily dosing.
No boxed warning. Contraindicated in prior hypersensitivity to the drug or its inactive ingredients; contusion and gait disturbance are the commonest reactions.
The mechanism by which it works in ALS is not known.
The generic name begins with E and has nine letters.
